O fundo de todas as telas. Também o text: The background of every screen. Also the text inside the lit tags, such as MAN and AUTO BW.
A borda e as linhas que dividem a tela p: The border and the lines that divide the main screen and the RDS and AF screens. In the touch menus, the background of the buttons.
O número grande da frequência e o nível: The big frequency number and the signal level.
Os textos fixos: MHz, kHz, dBµV, CN, US,: The fixed texts: MHz, kHz, dBµV, CN, US, MP, the meter scales, the battery outline and the names and titles in the menus.
Os valores que mudam: CN, US, MP, os val: The values that change: CN, US, MP, the values in the menus, the bands in the selector and the modulation peak mark. The speaker turns this color when the squelch cuts the sound.
O fundo das etiquetas acesas: o modo de: The background of the lit tags: the tuning mode (MAN, AUTO or MEM), AUTO BW, iMS and EQ.
O nome da estação (PS), o PI, o PTY, o R: The station name (PS), the PI, the PTY, the RadioText, the RDS clock and the lit RDS logo.
O ícone de estéreo, aceso quando a estaç: The stereo icon, lit when the station broadcasts in stereo.
O que está desligado: etiquetas apagadas: What is off: unlit tags, the stereo and RDS icons with no signal, missing TP, TA and AF, the empty part of the meters and the speaker while there is sound.
O começo do medidor de sinal, que passa: The start of the signal meter, which fades into the end color. Also the battery charge and the auto memory bar.
O fim do medidor de sinal, com sinal for: The end of the signal meter, with a strong signal. Also the empty battery and Wi-Fi without a connection.
O começo do medidor de modulação, que pa: The start of the modulation meter, which fades into the end color.
O fim do medidor de modulação e a marca: The end of the modulation meter and the peak mark when modulation goes over 80%.
O número da largura de banda quando ela: The bandwidth number when it is on automatic. On the AF screen, the frequency, the PS and the PI.
Os mesmos textos do RDS quando o sinal d: The same RDS texts when the RDS signal drops: the screen keeps the last text in this color.
Avisos: erro no RDS, sintonia fora do ce: Warnings: RDS errors, tuning off center, the number typed on the frequency keypad, the MEM tag while saving and the number of a used memory that would be overwritten.
Sinais de que está tudo bem: RDS sem err: Signs that all is well: RDS without errors, tuning centered, the tuning step, the RadioText A/B and the number of an empty memory.
A tensão ou a porcentagem da bateria, qu: The battery voltage or percentage, when the radio shows numbers instead of the icon.
